data.name: Doom of the Undying
data.detailed_description:
Unleash Carnage in Doom of the Undying: A Dark Fantasy Survivors-Like

Descend into Doom of the Undying, a fast-paced, dark fantasy, survivors-like adventure where your every second of survival fuels the escalating fury of the world – and your own deadly potential.

Inspired by genre titans like Vampire Survivors, Diablo, Halls of Torment, Death Must Die, and Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel, Doom of the Undying throws you into relentless waves of enemies. Choose your hero and craft a unique build through each run, leveraging brutal blessings, cursed upgrades, and risky dark pacts that demand blood for power.

Survive long enough, and awaken the horrifying bosses that await!

Key Features of Doom of the Undying

Fast-Paced Survivors-Like Action: Experience intense, top-down arena combat where dodging, kiting, and annihilating relentless hordes are essential for survival.

Deep Character Builds: Create absurdly powerful synergies by stacking diverse blessings, abilities, and gear to forge your ultimate monster hunter.

High-Risk, High-Reward Dark Pacts: Embrace timed challenges through dark pacts; claim powerful rewards or face devastating consequences.

Distinct Heroes and Playstyles: Explore different playstyles and power curves with each hero; choose your favorite and embrace a unique path to destruction!

Epic Boss Battles: Outlast the timer and confront towering nightmares, each with custom AI and designed to end your run in spectacular fashion.

Endless Replayability: With an ever-changing flow of gifts & challenges, no two runs are ever the same.

Dive Deeper into Doom of the Undying

  • Explore Diverse Zones: Conquer 4 unique zones, each featuring distinct enemy pools, stunning visuals, and procedurally generated music.

  • Master Unique Heroes: Discover 6 heroes with distinct playstyles, offering varied approaches to combat.

  • Conquer Challenging Bosses: Face 4 formidable end bosses (Colossus, Molten Overlord, Frost Lich King) with custom AI.

  • Survive Timed Encounters: Test your skills against mini-bosses.

  • Complete Epic Quests: Undertake 40+ quests across 4 tiers, earning valuable armor rewards.

  • Equip Powerful Armor: Utilize 9 equippable armor slots that persist across runs.

  • Discover Zone-Specific Blessings: Uncover 12 unique blessings per zone, enhancing your abilities

  • Upgrade Your Abilities: Utilize a robust ability system with diverse upgrades.

  • Engage with NPCs: Interact with an NPC quest system featuring multiple quest types (kill, survive zone, explore, slay elite).

  • Embrace Dark Pacts: Test yourself with mid-run dark pacts and objectives.

  • Compete on Leaderboards: Strive for the top spot on per-zone leaderboards.

  • Survive Blood Moons, Bone Storms, and Whiteout Blizzards: Every realm unleashes its own Hell Events that rewrite the rules mid-run and punish the unprepared

  • Unlock New Content: Progress through the game by unlocking zones.

  • Soul Store: Defeat mobs and bosses to earn Soul Coins, then spend them in the Soul Store to evolve your hero or unlock powerful pet companions.

  • Full Gamepad Support: Enjoy complete gamepad compatibility for seamless gameplay.

  • Immerse Yourself: Watch the immersive intro cinematic.

The further you venture, the more the Undying puts you to the test.

Will you succumb to the darkness or transform into something even more terrifying?

P.S:

FOR STEAM DECK: Use the recommended WASD + Mouse controller mapping

FOR PC/WINDOWS HANDHELDS (ROG ALLY ETC): Use the XBOX gamepad mapping

data.short_description: Survive rising hell hordes in a ruthless survivors-like where every second alive makes you stronger… and the world deadlier. Build wild synergies, face brutal bosses, and see how long your legend lives.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64‑bit (22H2
  • Processor: Dual‑core 64‑bit, ~2.0 GHz (Intel i3 4th gen / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU that supports hardware-accelerated OpenGL/DirectX (Intel HD 4000/4600 or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64‑bit
  • Processor: Quad‑core (Intel i5 / Ryzen 3+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620+ / any modest dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
